root_cause_summary: Connection starvation caused by runaway bulk extraction batch without pool throttling.

timeline_events.event: Anomaly detected in PostgreSQL latency metric
P1 Incident triggered and owner auto-assigned
PostgreSQL service restarted and pool refreshed
Traffic restored and incident marked resolved

impact_summary: 12 requests failed during 28.6s automated recovery window. Zero permanent data loss.
lessons_learned: Automated restart successfully resolved transient starvation within 28.6s.
Backpressure limits must be enforced on batch submission endpoints.

preventive_actions.title: Increase PostgreSQL max_connections and enable pgbouncer pooling
Add predictive saturation alert on active database worker handles
Implement read-replica automatic failover circuit breaker
